full_year_x_2_blocks_extrapolation.note: Linear extrapolation over a ~37x row-count scale-up from this measurement (5265 -> 196560 rows); treat as an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE signal, not a precise forecast. reconcile's ratio is per-SINGLE-partition (its loop never holds more than one year's frames at once); merge's ratio is for ALL years held simultaneously (its own list-comprehension-then-concat). Both ratios already exceed what an 8 GiB budget can absorb at full-year x 2-block scale for a 9-VP-instance study with profile structs on every row -- this is the next real memory blocker the packet asked to detect, not fix.
